elements.name: Superior Darkvision
elements.desc: Your darkvision has a radius of 120 feet. You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

elements.name: Duergar Resilience
elements.desc: You have advantage on saving throws against illusions and against being charmed or paralyzed.

elements.name: Duergar Magic
elements.desc: When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the enlarge/reduce spell on yourself once with this trait, using only the spell's enlarge option. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the invisibility spell on yourself once with this trait. You don't need material components for either spell, and you can't cast them while you're in direct sunlight, although sunlight has no effect on them once cast. You regain the ability to cast these spells with this trait when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
elements.desc: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when you, the target of your attack, or whatever you are trying to perceive is in direct sunlight.

elements.name: Duergar
elements.desc: The gray dwarves, or duergar, live deep in the Underdark. +1 Strength. Superior Darkvision (120 ft), Undercommon, Duergar Resilience, Duergar Magic, Sunlight Sensitivity.

elements.name: Silent Speech
elements.desc: You can speak telepathically to any creature within 30 feet of you. The creature understands you only if the two of you share a language. You can speak telepathically in this way to one creature at a time.

elements.name: Ghostwise Halfling
elements.desc: Ghostwise halflings trace their ancestry back to a war among halfling tribes that sent their ancestors into flight from Luiren. +1 Wisdom, plus Silent Speech.

elements.name: Stone Camouflage
elements.desc: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.

elements.name: Svirfneblin
elements.desc: The deep gnomes of the Underdark are dour and serious compared to their cheerful surface kin. +1 Dexterity. Superior Darkvision (120 ft), Stone Camouflage, Undercommon.
